Geiger Ads

241 ads copied from the 19 pages of the claude.ai ads design project: the Geiger Events sets, New Formats and one page per suite product. Each ad is built at 540 px and exports at 2× (1080 × 1080, 1080 × 1350, 1080 × 1920). Run node marketing/ads/render.mjs to regenerate the PNGs in marketing/ads/png/.
